purpose: A reproducible, zero-cost pilot for the environmental-condition hypothesis before expanding the registered 2015-2025 protocol.

time_window.interpretation: pilot evidence only; not a ten-year trend or causal estimate

inputs.fire: Existing paired S-NPP VIIRS VNP14IMG/VNP03IMG 2015 diagnostic subset
inputs.rainfall: Existing CHIRPS 2015 support window; query remaining dates remotely only when needed
inputs.vegetation: Existing QA-checked MOD13Q1 2014-2015 composites; sample event-linked values remotely for missing support
inputs.weather: Existing ERA5-Land 2015 monthly files; retain only derived event-level summaries
inputs.land_cover: Frozen MapBiomas Indonesia Collection 4.1.1 2014 forest mask and fraction
inputs.peat: Frozen peat/drainage provenance as sensitivity input, not a primary causal exposure

required: pre-fire rainfall, VPD/wind/soil-water and vegetation summaries
association model with uncertainty and a missingness report
not_claimed: causal attribution to companies or government
